data.reasoning: The package is a standard Python AUR package that downloads its source from PyPI with pinned SHA256 checksums. The build and package functions use standard Python tooling. The install script and systemd service file contain only benign, expected configuration and user guidance. The disagreement was solely due to a tool error in one of the models.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an inconclusive verdict because it encountered an HTTP 400 API error while performing the full review of the PKGBUILD. The deepseek model successfully reviewed the PKGBUILD and correctly identified it as safe, noting the standard PyPI source and build steps.
coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to complete the PKGBUILD review due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), resulting in an inconclusive file verdict.
learnings: The audit orchestration layer should implement automatic retries for transient LLM API errors (such as HTTP 400 or 500 responses) to prevent a single file failure from forcing an overall inconclusive package verdict.

When a model fails on a critical file like the PKGBUILD due to an API error, the system could potentially fall back to the initial sourcing safety check or rely on the consensus of other models that successfully completed the review.
